title: Plant pot saucer
prompt: Round saucer to go under a plant pot: 120 mm across at the top rim, 100 mm across at the bottom, 15 mm tall. 3 mm thick floor, and walls 2 mm thick (measured horizontally) that slope outwards.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
120 mm across the rim, 15 mm tall, ±0.2 mm
The sloped inner and outer walls are two cones
Three flat faces: underside, floor and rim
